note: Public, non-secret settings for the live stats (read by /api and by js/live-stats.js). display holds every word the live stats show on the page; topPosts.show false hides the top-posts strip. refreshMinutes: how old the cached snapshot may get before /api/stats fetches again (15 to 1440). showPlatforms: which platforms the page shows, in order. platforms.*.enabled: false stops the server from calling that platform at all. platforms.*.documented: a total you can prove with a screenshot; the site shows max(live, documented) per platform, so it never double counts. facebook is enabled but stays off (status disabled, no calls to Meta) until FACEBOOK_PAGE_ID is set in Vercel, because only Pages have an insights API (see docs/SOCIAL-API-SETUP.md step 9). Never put keys or tokens in this file: it is public.
